Dinh Bà Lớn Tướng Lê Kim Định sits on Đường Dinh Bà and most visitors drive straight past. A traditional Vietnamese temple dedicated to a revered female general. Incense burning, offerings laid out, genuine community life happening around you.

4.6 stars from 272 reviews, almost all locals. That ratio tells you everything.
